business_overview.one_sentence: The group provides property management, commercial operational services, and since 2025 property letting and related services, mainly in the PRC.
business_overview.revenue_model: Fees for property management and value-added services, commercial operation and tenant sourcing services, and rental income related to commercial operation services.
business_notes: All customer revenue is derived from operations and services rendered in the PRC, and substantially all non-current assets other than FVTOCI investments are located in the PRC.
China Aoyuan ceased to be a substantial shareholder since 21 October 2024, but receivables/payables with its group companies remain material.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: 2025 operating cash flow was only RMB22.171m versus parent net profit RMB51.568m. Working capital absorbed RMB238.995m before tax, mainly receivables and former substantial shareholder related balances, so cash profit must be materially haircut.

gaps: The annual report does not split group cash by every subsidiary, bank location, or dividend remittance readiness.
Only 2025 and 2024 full cash-flow comparatives were extracted from this annual report; a full three-year median would require 2023 annual report extraction.
Maintenance versus growth capex is not explicitly disclosed; 2025 PPE purchase is used as a conservative maintenance-capex proxy.
